title: Azure DevOps Connections
text:
Breadcrumbs
The
Azure DevOps (ADO) Connections
section allows administrators to link ADO projects with specific Leapwork teams and define which custom fields should be completed when creating bugs in ADO from Leapwork.
This section lists all Azure DevOps (ADO) projects by each configured
ADO connection
.
Note:
If no ADO connections exist, this section will not show projects.
Note:
ID is the default unique identifier for ADO test cases, but you can choose a different field under
Configure fields / test cases
for each project. If you change the identifier, existing test cases require an explicit sync in Leapwork to use the new field. Going forward, only test cases with a value in the selected identifier field will be imported, and test cases without a value will be skipped.
The Azure DevOps Connections table is grouped by connection and shows each ADO project available under that connection. Use the pencil icons in the editable columns to configure project-level access and field mapping.
Column
Description
Project Name
Displays the Azure DevOps project name for the selected connection.
Team
Shows the Leapwork team assigned to the project. If no team is assigned, the column shows
Assign Team
. Click the pencil icon to choose which Leapwork teams can use that ADO project.
Configure fields / bugs
Defines which Azure DevOps fields are available when creating bugs from Leapwork. Click the pencil icon to open the
Select custom fields
dialog and select the fields to include.
Configure fields / test cases
Defines which Azure DevOps field Leapwork uses as the unique identifier for imported ADO test cases. The default value is
ID
. Click the pencil icon to open the
Configure field
dialog and choose a different identifier field if required.
Only users with the
Administrator
role can configure Azure DevOps project access and custom field settings in the
Azure DevOps Connections
section.
How to Assign Teams to an ADO Project
In the
Team
column, click the pencil icon for the project.
A modal window opens with a list of all Leapwork teams.
Check the boxes for teams that should access the specific ADO project.
Click
Apply
to save your selection.
Note:
Only members of the assigned teams will be able to publish results and create bugs in that project from Leapwork.
How to Configure Fields for Bugs
In the
Configure fields/bugs
column, click the pencil icon for the project.
The
Select custom fields
dialog opens and displays the Azure DevOps fields available for bug creation. Some required fields, such as
Found In
,
Priority
,
Repro Steps
,
Severity
, and
Title
, may already be selected and disabled.
Select the fields that should be shown when users create ADO bugs from Leapwork.
Click
Apply
to save the selected bug fields for the project.
The selected fields will appear in the
Create a bug in ADO
dialog when submitting a bug from Leapwork.
How to Configure the Test Case Identifier Field
In the
Configure fields/test cases
column, click the pencil icon for the project.
The
Configure field
dialog opens and lists the available Azure DevOps fields that can be used as the test case identifier.
Select the field Leapwork should use to identify imported ADO test cases. By default,
ID
is selected.
Click
Apply
to save the identifier field for the project.
Note:
If you change the identifier field, existing test cases require an explicit sync in Leapwork to start using the new field. After the change, only test cases with a value in the selected identifier field will be imported; test cases without a value will be skipped.
